name: CI/CD Resume Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Simulate Build Process
        run: echo "Building the website..."

      - name: Deployment Success Message
        run: echo "Website deployed successfully!"
